raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
> Kimi-K3 on gfx950 series (all drafts): #44547 gfx950 verify argmax + tuned rows, #44548 KDA, #44549 MLA decode, #44550 MLA prefill, #44551 → #44552 → #44553 collectives, MoE decode, MoE prefill. The end-to-end numbers in each PR are for all seven together.

## Motivation

Agentic Kimi-K3 traffic is mostly extends over long cached prefixes (50K tokens here). On the aiter FP8 MLA prefill
path each such extend re-expands the whole cached latent prefix per MLA layer through index_select, two casts, a
contiguous copy, kv_b_proj, the rope cat, head padding and two fp8 casts; for a short extend that expansion costs far
more than the new tokens' attention.

## Modifications

Both paths are gated on gfx950 and an FP8 latent cache.

- `_expand_prefix_kv_fp8`: the prefix K/V for the FP8 prefill come from two launches around kv_b_proj
  (`gather_prefix_latent`, then `pack_prefix_kv_fp8`: rope cat, head tiling to the kernel's 16 heads, fp8 casts),
  byte-identical to the chain they replace; `mla_fp8_prefill_attn` skips re-padding them.
- `uses_absorbed_cached_extend()`: an extend whose requests each add at most
  `SGLANG_ROCM_MLA_ABSORBED_EXTEND_MAX_TOKENS` (64) tokens after a cached prefix takes the absorbed MLA path
  (`handle_attention_aiter`), and the aiter backend attends the latent cache directly with absorbed queries
  (`mla_absorbed_extend`: 4 queries x 16 heads per program over one KV split, fp8 QK, LSE combine), planned once
  per batch in the extend metadata.

| New env var | Default |
|---|---|
| `SGLANG_ROCM_MLA_ABSORBED_EXTEND_MAX_TOKENS` | 64 |

## Accuracy Tests

**Setup for every number below:** 8x MI350X (gfx950, 1000 W), Kimi-K3 (MXFP4 MoE, bf16 attention) at TP8 with EAGLE3
(topk 1, 3 steps, 4 draft tokens), FP8 KV cache, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, aiter's K3 FlyDSL kernels
(`AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1`), CUDA graphs for bs 1/2/4/8/16, and an aiter bf16 GEMM table with K3 rows re-tuned on this pod with HBM-resident weights
(`AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_BF16`; not part of this PR, it belongs in aiter's model configs). EAGLE3 on K3 needs the
aux-capture commit of #43599, applied locally for these runs. Microbenchmarks rotate their weights through HBM.
Per-feature numbers were measured on the integration branch of this series as each piece landed (Oct 13-14,
earlier `main`); the end-to-end numbers are from the integration of all seven PRs rebased on `main` b67785153a,
together with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848.

- GSM8K 400 with the absorbed extend on: 0.985 / accept 3.622; short questions after the 50K context answer
  correctly. End-to-end integration: see below.
- `test_mla_prefill_gfx950.py` (new): ragged absorbed extends with and without a prefix against a reference attention
  (cosine > 0.9995); the prefix pack is byte-identical to the unfused expansion for 1 / 37 / 3000 rows.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Prefix expansion per MLA layer at a 50K prefix: 1645 -> 401 us (~30 ms per agentic turn over 24 layers).
- Absorbed extend per layer at a 50K prefix: 101 / 202 / 351 / 667 / 1279 us for 8 / 32 / 64 / 128 / 256 new tokens
  vs ~420-500 us for the expansion path (both scale with the prefix), hence the 64-token default.
- In-server turn TTFT, 50K cached prefix + 62 new tokens: 265 / 261 / 243 ms -> 249 / 246 / 249 ms.

### End to end (all seven PRs)

Integration of the seven PRs on `main` b67785153a, with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848; agentic replay of
lightseekorg/agentic-dataset SWE-smith conversations (multi-turn, ~50K-token cached prefixes, 500 output tokens,
greedy), EAGLE3 as above. TokenSpeed (7e2f1deb, same pod, same workload) for reference.

| Concurrency | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SGLang, tok/s/user | 217.2 | 156.6 | 114.1 | 73.4 | 43.4 |
| TokenSpeed, tok/s/user | 188.1 | 129.5 | 86.1 | 59.7 | 35.5 |

786/786 requests OK. GSM8K 400: 0.9825 / accept length 3.619. Decode cycle C1 / C4 / C16: 15.8 / 23.2 / 38.9 ms;
agentic turn TTFT (50K cached + 1.9K new tokens) 230-248 ms; uncached 50K-token prefill 3.27 s.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

detail.title: [Perf] [AMD] mla: FP8 prefix K/V pack and absorbed short cached extends for Kimi-K3 prefill on gfx950

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,269 @@
+"""Absorbed MLA cached extend over an FP8 latent cache (gfx950).
+
+A short extend after a long cached prefix attends the paged latent cache
+directly with absorbed queries ``[T, H, kv_lora_rank + rope]`` instead of
+expanding every prefix token to per-head K/V through kv_b_proj. Both costs grow
+with the prefix and this one also with the new tokens, so it serves only short
+extends (SGLANG_ROCM_MLA_ABSORBED_EXTEND_MAX_TOKENS). Each program packs BLOCK_Q
+query positions times BLOCK_H heads into the MFMA M dimension so one KV tile
+feeds all of them, over one split of the keys; a second kernel combines the
+splits by their LSE.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# BLOCK_Q x BLOCK_H = 64 rows keep the [64, 512] fp32 accumulator in registers on gfx950 at
+# 4 warps (402 VGPRs incl. AGPRs, no spills); 128 rows spill. Measured at a 50K prefix.
+_BLOCK_Q = 4
+_BLOCK_H = 16
+# One program covers every head of its query block.
+MAX_HEADS = _BLOCK_H
+_BLOCK_N = 32
+# Programs to aim for across the batch, and the minimum keys per split.
+_TARGET_PROGRAMS = 512
+_MIN_SPLIT_KEYS = 512
+_MAX_SPLITS = 64
+
+
+class AbsorbedExtendPlan(NamedTuple):
+    """Per-batch work list: the request and first query of each BLOCK_Q block."""
+
+    block_req: torch.Tensor
+    block_q0: torch.Tensor
+    num_splits: int
+    total_q: int
+
+
+def plan_absorbed_extend(
+    extend_lens_cpu, kv_lens_cpu, device: torch.device
+) -> AbsorbedExtendPlan:
+    """The work list of mla_absorbed_extend from the per-request host lengths."""
+    reqs, q0s = [], []
+    for b, q_len in enumerate(extend_lens_cpu):
+        for q0 in range(0, int(q_len), _BLOCK_Q):
+            reqs.append(b)
+            q0s.append(q0)
+    max_kv = max(int(k) for k in kv_lens_cpu)
+    num_splits = max(
+        1,
+        min(
+            _MAX_SPLITS,
+            _TARGET_PROGRAMS // max(len(reqs), 1),
+            triton.cdiv(max_kv, _MIN_SPLIT_KEYS),
+        ),
+    )
+    work = torch.tensor([reqs, q0s], dtype=torch.int32).to(device, non_blocking=True)
+    return AbsorbedExtendPlan(
+        work[0], work[1], num_splits, int(sum(int(x) for x in extend_lens_cpu))
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _absorbed_extend_kernel(
+    Q,
+    KV,
+    KV_INDICES,
+    KV_INDPTR,
+    QO_INDPTR,
+    BLOCK_REQ,
+    BLOCK_Q0,
+    PART_O,
+    PART_LSE,
+    sm_scale,
+    kv_scale,
+    stride_qt,
+    stride_qh,
+    stride_kv,
+    stride_ps,
+    stride_pt,
+    stride_ph,
+    stride_ls,
+    stride_lt,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    LATENT: tl.constexpr,
+    ROPE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_SPLITS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_Q: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    sid = tl.program_id(1)
+    b = tl.load(BLOCK_REQ + pid)
+    q0 = tl.load(BLOCK_Q0 + pid)
+    qo_start = tl.load(QO_INDPTR + b)
+    q_len = tl.load(QO_INDPTR + b + 1) - qo_start
+    kv_start = tl.load(KV_INDPTR + b)
+    prefix = tl.load(KV_INDPTR + b + 1) - kv_start - q_len
+
+    M: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_Q * BLOCK_H
+    rows = tl.arange(0, M)
+    qi = q0 + rows // BLOCK_H
+    hh = rows % BLOCK_H
+    row_ok = (qi < q_len) & (hh < H)
+    qpos = prefix + qi
+    # This block's queries see keys [0, kv_hi); this program takes one split.
+    kv_hi = prefix + tl.minimum(q0 + BLOCK_Q, q_len)
+    split = tl.cdiv(tl.cdiv(kv_hi, NUM_SPLITS), BLOCK_N) * BLOCK_N
+    lo = sid * split
+    hi = tl.minimum(lo + split, kv_hi)
+
+    offs_l = tl.arange(0, LATENT)
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, ROPE)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    q_row = (
+        Q + (qo_start + qi).to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_qt + hh[:, None] * stride_qh
+    )
+    q_nope = tl.load(q_row + offs_l[None, :], mask=row_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+    q_rope = tl.load(q_row + LATENT + offs_r[None, :], mask=row_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+
+    m_i = tl.full([M], float("-inf"), tl.float32)
+    l_i = tl.zeros([M], tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.zeros([M, LATENT], tl.float32)
+    for start in range(lo, hi, BLOCK_N):
+        k_ok = start + offs_n < hi
+        idx = tl.load(KV_INDICES + kv_start + start + offs_n, mask=k_ok, other=0)
+        k_row = KV + idx.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_kv
+        k_nope = tl.load(k_row + offs_l[None, :], mask=k_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+        k_rope = tl.load(
+            k_row + LATENT + offs_r[None, :], mask=k_ok[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        s = tl.dot(q_nope, tl.trans(k_nope)) + tl.dot(q_rope, tl.trans(k_rope))
+        s = s * (sm_scale * kv_scale)
+        seen = (start + offs_n)[None, :] <= qpos[:, None]
+        s = tl.where(seen & k_ok[None, :], s, float("-inf"))
+        m_new = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(s, 1))
+        # Rows that have seen no key yet keep m = -inf; shift by 0 there.
+        m_safe = tl.where(m_new == float("-inf"), 0.0, m_new)
+        alpha = tl.exp(m_i - m_safe)
+        p = tl.exp(s - m_safe[:, None])
+        l_i = l_i * alpha + tl.sum(p, 1)
+        acc = acc * alpha[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(tl.bfloat16), k_nope.to(tl.bfloat16))
+        m_i = m_new
+
+    has = l_i > 0.0
+    out = acc * (kv_scale / tl.where(has, l_i, 1.0))[:, None]
+    lse = tl.where(has, m_i + tl.log(tl.where(has, l_i, 1.0)), float("-inf"))
+    t = (qo_start + qi).to(tl.int64)
+    po = PART_O + sid * stride_ps + t[:, None] * stride_pt + hh[:, None] * stride_ph
+    tl.store(po + offs_l[None, :], out, mask=row_ok[:, None])
+    tl.store(PART_LSE + sid * stride_ls + t * stride_lt + hh, lse, mask=row_ok)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _combine_kernel(
+    PART_O,
+    PART_LSE,
+    O,
+    stride_ps,
+    stride_pt,
+    stride_ph,
+    stride_ls,
+    stride_lt,
+    stride_ot,
+    stride_oh,
+    NUM_SPLITS: tl.constexpr,
+    SPLITS_P2: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_l = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, SPLITS_P2)
+    lse = tl.load(
+        PART_LSE + offs_s * stride_ls + t * stride_lt + h,
+        mask=offs_s < NUM_SPLITS,
+        other=float("-inf"),
+    )
+    w = tl.exp(lse - tl.max(lse, 0))
+    w = w / tl.sum(w, 0)
+    part = tl.load(
+        PART_O
+        + offs_s[:, None] * stride_ps
+        + t * stride_pt
+        + h * stride_ph
+        + offs_l[None, :],
+        mask=(w > 0.0)[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    acc = tl.sum(part * w[:, None], 0)
+    tl.store(O + t * stride_ot + h * stride_oh + offs_l, acc.to(O.dtype.element_ty))
+
+
+def mla_absorbed_extend(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+    qo_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+    plan: AbsorbedExtendPlan,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    kv_lora_rank: int,
+    kv_scale: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """o [T, H, kv_lora_rank] (bf16) for absorbed q [T, H, kv_lora_rank + rope]
+    (fp8 e4m3, unit scale) over kv_cache [slots, kv_lora_rank + rope] (fp8 e4m3
+    times kv_scale) whose kv_indices segments (kv_indptr) hold each request's
+    prefix and then its extend tokens; causal on global positions. H <= MAX_HEADS."""
+    total_q, num_heads, head_dim = q.shape
+    rope = head_dim - kv_lora_rank
+    splits = plan.num_splits
+    part_o = q.new_empty(
+        (splits, total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    part_lse = q.new_empty((splits, total_q, num_heads), dtype=torch.float32)
+    _absorbed_extend_kernel[(plan.block_req.numel(), splits)](
+        q,
+        kv_cache,
+        kv_indices,
+        kv_indptr,
+        qo_indptr,
+        plan.block_req,
+        plan.block_q0,
+        part_o,
+        part_lse,
+        sm_scale,
+        kv_scale,
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        kv_cache.stride(0),
+        part_o.stride(0),
+        part_o.stride(1),
+        part_o.stride(2),
+        part_lse.stride(0),
+        part_lse.stride(1),
+        H=num_heads,
+        LATENT=kv_lora_rank,
+        ROPE=rope,
+        NUM_SPLITS=splits,
+        BLOCK_Q=_BLOCK_Q,
+        BLOCK_H=_BLOCK_H,
+        BLOCK_N=_BLOCK_N,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=2,
+    )
+    o = q.new_empty((total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    block_l = 128
+    _combine_kernel[(total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank // block_l)](
+        part_o,
+        part_lse,
+        o,
+        part_o.stride(0),

+"""MLA cached-prefix K/V expansion for an FP8 prefill kernel, in two launches.
+
+An extend over a cached prefix re-expands the whole latent cache:
+    gather:  kvc = bf16(cache[idx, :R]), k_pe = cache[idx, R:]     (fp8 cache)
+    kv_b_proj GEMM on kvc  -> kv [L, H, Dn + Dv]
+    pack:    k = fp8(cat(kv[:, h, :Dn], k_pe)), v = fp8(kv[:, h, Dn:])
+             for output heads h' = 0 .. Hp - 1 tiled from h = h' % H
+replacing index_select, two casts, a contiguous copy, the k_pe cat, the head
+repeat and two fp8 casts. The casts are plain round-to-nearest conversions, as
+torch's .to(float8_e4m3fn) does for in-range values; k_pe keeps its cached bytes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _gather_latent_kernel(
+    cache_ptr,  # [slots, R + P] fp8 rows
+    idx_ptr,  # [L]
+    kvc_ptr,  # [L, R] bf16
+    pe_ptr,  # [L, P] fp8
+    L,
+    stride_cache,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    row_mask = rows < L
+    src = tl.load(idx_ptr + rows, mask=row_mask, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+    o_r = tl.arange(0, R)
+    lat = tl.load(
+        cache_ptr + src[:, None] * stride_cache + o_r[None, :],
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        kvc_ptr + rows[:, None].to(tl.int64) * R + o_r[None, :],
+        lat.to(kvc_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+    )
+    o_p = tl.arange(0, P)
+    pe = tl.load(
+        cache_ptr + src[:, None] * stride_cache + R + o_p[None, :],
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        pe_ptr + rows[:, None].to(tl.int64) * P + o_p[None, :],
+        pe,
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_kv_kernel(
+    kv_ptr,  # [L, H, DN + DV] bf16, row stride stride_kv
+    pe_ptr,  # [L, P] fp8
+    k_ptr,  # [L, HP, DN + P] fp8
+    v_ptr,  # [L, HP, DV] fp8
+    L,
+    stride_kv,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    HP: tl.constexpr,
+    DN: tl.constexpr,
+    DV: tl.constexpr,
+    P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    row_mask = rows[:, None] < L
+    rows64 = rows[:, None].to(tl.int64)
+    o_n = tl.arange(0, DN)
+    o_v = tl.arange(0, DV)
+    o_p = tl.arange(0, P)
+    src = kv_ptr + rows64 * stride_kv + h * (DN + DV)
+    k_nope = tl.load(src + o_n[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0).to(
+        k_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    )
+    v = tl.load(src + DN + o_v[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0).to(
+        v_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    )
+    pe = tl.load(pe_ptr + rows64 * P + o_p[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0)
+    # Output head h, and h + H while it is a tiled padding head.
+    for rep in tl.static_range(0, HP, H):
+        if rep + h < HP:
+            k_row = k_ptr + (rows64 * HP + rep + h) * (DN + P)
+            tl.store(k_row + o_n[None, :], k_nope, mask=row_mask)
+            tl.store(k_row + DN + o_p[None, :], pe, mask=row_mask)
+            tl.store(
+                v_ptr + (rows64 * HP + rep + h) * DV + o_v[None, :], v, mask=row_mask
+            )
+
+
+def gather_prefix_latent(
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor, kv_indices: torch.Tensor, kv_lora_rank: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """kv_cache [slots, 1, R + P] fp8, kv_indices [L] -> (bf16 latent [L, R],
+    fp8 rope part [L, P])."""
+    cache = kv_cache.view(kv_cache.shape[0], -1)
+    width = cache.shape[1]
+    rope = width - kv_lora_rank
+    num_rows = kv_indices.shape[0]
+    kvc = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=kv_cache.device
+    )
+    pe = torch.empty((num_rows, rope), dtype=kv_cache.dtype, device=kv_cache.device)
+    if num_rows:
+        block_l = 16
+        _gather_latent_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_rows, block_l),)](
+            cache,
+            kv_indices,
+            kvc,
+            pe,
+            num_rows,
+            cache.stride(0),
+            R=kv_lora_rank,
+            P=rope,
+            BLOCK_L=block_l,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+    return kvc, pe
+
+
+def pack_prefix_kv_fp8(
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    k_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_heads_padded: int,
+    nope_dim: int,
+    v_dim: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """kv [L, H * (Dn + Dv)] bf16 (kv_b_proj output), k_pe [L, P] fp8 ->
+    (k [L, Hp, Dn + P], v [L, Hp, Dv]) in k_pe's fp8 dtype, heads tiled to Hp."""
+    num_rows = kv.shape[0]
+    rope = k_pe.shape[1]
+    assert kv.shape[1] == num_heads * (nope_dim + v_dim) and kv.stride(1) == 1
+    assert k_pe.is_contiguous() and num_heads_padded >= num_heads
+    k = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, num_heads_padded, nope_dim + rope),
+        dtype=k_pe.dtype,
+        device=kv.device,
+    )
+    v = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, num_heads_padded, v_dim), dtype=k_pe.dtype, device=kv.device
+    )
+    if num_rows:
+        block_l = 16
+        _pack_kv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_rows, block_l), num_heads)](
+            kv,
+            k_pe,
+            k,
+            v,
+            num_rows,
+            kv.stride(0),
+            H=num_heads,
+            HP=num_heads_padded,
+            DN=nope_dim,
+            DV=v_dim,
+            P=rope,
+            BLOCK_L=block_l,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+    return k, v

+"""The gfx950 Kimi-K3 MLA cached-prefix kernels against reference attention and expansion."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.mla_absorbed_extend import (
+    mla_absorbed_extend,
+    plan_absorbed_extend,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.mla_prefix_kv_pack import (
+    gather_prefix_latent,
+    pack_prefix_kv_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# backend-specific: both kernels feed aiter's gfx950 FP8 MLA prefill path.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# Kimi-K3 TP8 MLA: 12 heads per rank (16 in the FP8 prefill kernel), 512-wide
+# latent, 64-wide rope, 128-wide nope and value heads.
+H, HP, R, P, DN, DV = 12, 16, 512, 64, 128, 128
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+
+
+def _attend_latent(q, cache, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, kv_indices, scale):
+    out = torch.empty(q.shape[0], H, R, device="cuda")
+    keys_all = cache.float()
+    for b in range(qo_indptr.numel() - 1):
+        q0, q1 = qo_indptr[b].item(), qo_indptr[b + 1].item()
+        k0, k1 = kv_indptr[b].item(), kv_indptr[b + 1].item()
+        keys = keys_all[kv_indices[k0:k1].long()]
+        n_q, n_k = q1 - q0, k1 - k0
+        s = torch.einsum("qhd,kd->hqk", q[q0:q1].float(), keys) * scale
+        pos = torch.arange(n_k - n_q, n_k, device="cuda")[:, None]
+        s = s.masked_fill(
+            torch.arange(n_k, device="cuda")[None, :] > pos, float("-inf")
+        )
+        out[q0:q1] = torch.einsum("hqk,kd->qhd", torch.softmax(s, -1), keys[:, :R])
+    return out
+
+
+def _pad_heads(x, padded):
+    reps = -(-padded // x.shape[1])
+    return x.repeat(1, reps, 1)[:, :padded, :].contiguous()
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_gfx95_supported(), "requires gfx950")
+class TestMlaPrefillGfx950(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_absorbed_extend_attends_prefix_and_earlier_positions(self):
+        """Ragged extends after cached prefixes (and one without) attend every
+        prefix key and their own earlier positions only."""
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        scale = 1.0 / 192**0.5
+        for prefix_lens, ext_lens in (
+            ([1000], [37]),
+            ([4000, 0, 2500], [256, 128, 1]),
+            ([300, 7000], [5, 200]),
+        ):
+            kv_lens = [p + e for p, e in zip(prefix_lens, ext_lens)]
+            cache = (torch.randn(sum(kv_lens) + 1, R + P, device="cuda") * 0.5).to(FP8)
+            kv_indices = (torch.randperm(sum(kv_lens), device="cuda") + 1).int()
+            kv_indptr = torch.tensor(
+                [0, *torch.tensor(kv_lens).cumsum(0).tolist()],
+                device="cuda",
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+            )
+            qo_indptr = torch.tensor(
+                [0, *torch.tensor(ext_lens).cumsum(0).tolist()],
+                device="cuda",
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+            )
+            q = (torch.randn(sum(ext_lens), H, R + P, device="cuda") * 0.3).to(FP8)
+            plan = plan_absorbed_extend(ext_lens, kv_lens, q.device)
+            out = mla_absorbed_extend(
+                q, cache, kv_indices, kv_indptr, qo_indptr, plan, scale, R
+            )
+            ref = _attend_latent(q, cache, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, kv_indices, scale)
+            cos = F.cosine_similarity(out.float().flatten(), ref.flatten(), dim=0)
+            with self.subTest(prefix_lens=prefix_lens, ext_lens=ext_lens):
+                self.assertGreater(cos.item(), 0.9995)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), ref, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_prefix_kv_pack_matches_unfused_expansion_bitwise(self):
+        """The two-launch expansion must produce the exact fp8 K/V bytes the
+        aiter backend's index_select / cast / cat / pad_heads / cast chain does:
+        padding heads tiled as h % H, the rope part carried as cached bytes."""
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        slots = 4096
+        cache = (torch.randn(slots, 1, R + P, device="cuda") * 2).to(FP8)
+        w = (torch.randn(H * (DN + DV), R, device="cuda") * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        for num_rows in (1, 37, 3000):
+            idx = torch.randperm(slots, device="cuda")[:num_rows].to(torch.int32)
+            kvc_ref, k_pe = torch.split(
+                torch.index_select(cache, 0, idx), [R, P], dim=-1
+            )
+            kvc_ref = kvc_ref.to(torch.bfloat16).squeeze(1)
+            k_ref, v_ref = torch.split(
+                F.linear(kvc_ref, w).view(-1, H, DN + DV), [DN, DV], dim=-1
+            )
+            k_pe_heads = torch.broadcast_to(k_pe.to(torch.bfloat16), (num_rows, H, P))
+            k_ref = _pad_heads(torch.cat([k_ref, k_pe_heads], dim=-1), HP).to(FP8)
+            v_ref = _pad_heads(v_ref, HP).to(FP8)
+
+            kvc, pe = gather_prefix_latent(cache, idx, R)
+            k, v = pack_prefix_kv_fp8(
+                F.linear(kvc, w),
+                pe,
+                num_heads=H,
+                num_heads_padded=HP,
+                nope_dim=DN,
+                v_dim=DV,
+            )
+            with self.subTest(num_rows=num_rows):
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(kvc, kvc_ref))
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(k.view(torch.uint8), k_ref.view(torch.uint8))
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(v.view(torch.uint8), v_ref.view(torch.uint8))
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

Kimi-K3 on gfx950 merge queue (all drafts; they land one at a time in this order): 1 #44978 verify argmax + tuned bf16 rows · 2 #44979 MLA prefill · 3 #44980 streaming AttnRes · 4 #44981 MoE prefill · 5 #44982 KDA · 6 #44983 MLA decode prep · 7 #44984 MLA decode epilogue · 8 #44985 LL column tail · 9 #44986 fused all-reduce read · 10 #44987 fused route sort · 11 #44988 split MoE front + bank partials · 12 #44989 MLA q-norm + q_b. Replaces #44547-#44553.
